<!-- MtLoginPage.vue -->
<template>
  <v-main style="height: 100%" class="mainlogin">
    <v-container fluid fill-height>
      <v-row justify="center">
        <MtCard class="loginWindow pa-6" color="red">
          <!-- ロゴ -->
          <MtCard flat :width="cardWidth" color="blue">
            <!-- ログインフォーム -->
            <v-form
              @submit.prevent="login"
              class="d-flex flex-column align-center"
            >
              <MtTextField
                v-model="account"
                label="account"
                prepend-icon="mdi-account"
                :style="textFieldStyle"
              />
              <MtPasswordTextField
                v-model="password"
                label="password"
                :style="textFieldStyle"
              />
            </v-form>
            <v-btn
              :loading="loading"
              color="success"
              size="large"
              type="submit"
              variant="elevated"
              block
              :style="textFieldStyle"
            >
              LOGIN
            </v-btn>
          </MtCard>
        </MtCard>
      </v-row>
    </v-container>
  </v-main>
</template>

<script>
import MtCard from "@/components/MtCard.vue";
import MtTextField from "@/components/MtTextField.vue";
import MtPasswordTextField from "@/components/MtPasswordTextField.vue";

export default {
  components: {
    MtCard,
    MtTextField,
    MtPasswordTextField,
  },
  props: {
    //
  },
  data: () => ({
    height: 0,
    width: 0,
    cardWidth: 395,
    account: "",
    password: "",
    loading: false,
  }),
  mounted: async function () {
    //
  },
  computed: {
    textFieldStyle: function () {
      const width = this.cardWidth + "px";
      return { width: width, "margin-bottom": "10px" };
    },
  },
  methods: {
    login: async function () {
      this.loading = true;
      let result = false;
      await this.$mtapi.auth
        .login(this.account, this.password)
        .then((response) => (result = response.data))
        .catch((err) =>
          alert("error " + JSON.stringify(err.response.data.message))
        );

      if (result) {
        alert("result");
        this.loading = false;
      } else {
        location.reload();
      }
    },
  },
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.mainlogin {
  background: radial-gradient(#ffccff, #cc99ff) fixed;
}
.loginWindow {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 24px;
}
.login-dialog {
  opacity: 0.9;
}
</style>
